The '''M'dweshuui Stronghold''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Located southeast of the [[Varykino/Legends|Lake Retreat]] in the foothills of the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]], the cave was used as a compound by the [[Cult of M'dweshuu]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] of the [[Azure Cabal]] attacked the stronghold while using [[Emberlene Essence]]. In doing so, the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] cultists believed they were being attacked by the [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]].<ref name="SWG:CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The M'dweshuui Stronghold was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The M'dweshuui Stronghold was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Azure Cabal|Azure Cabal questline]],<ref name="SWG:CE" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="Chapter 6">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
